name: project-intelligence
description: Command entrypoints for the monorepo. Backend deps via uv, frontend via npm.

scripts.dev:api: uv run --project backend uvicorn app.main:app --reload --app-dir backend --port 8000
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:api: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: cd backend && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
